characterBible.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL character reference model sheet for a Traditional Chinese children's picture book for independent readers ages 7–9, 'Sea, Come to My Home!'. No words, letters, numbers, captions, logos or watermark anywhere. Four separate evenly spaced full-length figures on pure white paper, left to right: the BOY front, the BOY three-quarter; the GIRL front, the GIRL three-quarter. Each occupies its own quarter, no overlap, all shoes visible. These are two East Asian children about eight years old, natural child proportions about three heads tall, gentle expressive black pencil eyes, not anime, not 3D. BOY AN: slightly tousled short dark graphite hair, one small cowlick, pale aqua short sleeve T-shirt with exactly ONE muted coral horizontal stripe across the chest; terracotta/rust knee-length shorts; navy indoor slide slippers, no socks, no bag. GIRL YUANYUAN: centre-parted dark graphite hair in TWO low shoulder-length braids, no bows or clips; cream short sleeve T-shirt under a light lavender pinafore dress with ONE large square front pocket; mustard yellow indoor slippers, no socks or bag. Show their hands empty, clear fingers, relaxed curious expressions. ART DIRECTION: delicate flat grey GRAPHITE PENCIL contours with visibly cross-hatched, scribbly graphite hair; a few gentle COLORED PENCIL and dry pastel accents in aqua, lavender, coral, mustard. White paper is dominant. Modest pink cheeks, airy imperfect handmade lines, warm comic gesture, restrained color rather than fully painted skin. Fine paper grain, no glossy gradients, no volumetric airbrushing, no watercolor flood, no dense scenic background. Original faces and clothing, do not imitate an existing character. Keep all four figures consistent in height and scale, with lots of clean white separation.

illustrations.prompt:
An ORIGINAL children's picture-book illustration for ages 7–9. Very wide LANDSCAPE double-page composition, intended aspect ratio 16:10. NO text, no letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark or borders. Use the attached model sheet as the exact identity reference. AN is the boy with tousled short black graphite hair and a cowlick, pale aqua short-sleeve T-shirt with ONE coral horizontal chest stripe, terracotta shorts, navy indoor slide slippers. YUANYUAN is the girl with TWO low black braids and a centre part, cream short sleeve T-shirt, light lavender pinafore dress with ONE square front pocket, mustard indoor slippers. Same faces, clothes and child proportions in all scenes. Delicate flat GRAPHITE PENCIL contour, densely scribbled graphite hair, restrained colored-pencil accents, airy warm comic expression, slight paper grain on dominant PURE WHITE paper. No 3D, no photorealism, no glossy or painterly rendering, no full color background, no patterned wallpaper. Indoor floor-level water play on a simple very pale grey waterproof mat, a broad shallow PALE AQUA OVAL basin, clean clear water only INSIDE the basin, exactly THREE smooth grey rounded stones as little islands when present; one CLEAR plastic tumbler, white paper boat in early scenes, later a raft of exactly THREE parallel tan cork cylinders fastened with TWO coral rubber bands, no mast or sail. No other toys, no animals, no extra people. All faces and essential props away from the vertical center binding, no hands hiding important actions. Independently typeset words need genuinely blank pure white space as specified. Water is pale turquoise pencil ripple lines with lots of white, not a wall of blue.
A separate compact COVER CUTOUT on a truly TRANSPARENT background. The two children kneel on either side of a small shallow pale aqua oval washbasin, boy on left, girl on right, both smiling in delight at ONE white folded paper boat floating in the water. They look at the boat, not at the viewer. Show their whole bodies, slippers and the whole basin, clean silhouette with just a few tiny turquoise water ripple accents inside the basin. NO stones, NO corks, NO cup in this cover cutout. No rectangular white panel, no floor or room background, no frame. This cover image must fit a horizontal cutout below the separately typeset title. Warm open expressions and a clear friendly relationship.
